subject: TEST: Remotion fidelity test — port one section, render both, Qwen-review both
body:
---
MISSION: Remotion fidelity test for the HyperFrames video pipeline — port ONE real section composition to Remotion, render it with the same narration, and run the existing Qwen vision review on both renders. This is the decision gate for migrating the rendering middle.

CONTEXT: Local spike 001 already validated Remotion renders HyperFrames-class compositions with audio-driven duration (docs/remotion-evaluation.md). What is unproven is visual fidelity on a real section — that is your job.

REPO: https://github.com/jefhei/ytscripts (main, commit 9e6d34d — git pull)
FILES TO REFERENCE:
  - spikes/001-remotion-render/ — seed project (package.json, src/CTA.tsx, src/Root.tsx) — ported cta.html as the reference port
  - docs/remotion-vps-fidelity-test.md — full runbook, follow it
  - hyperscrips/scripts/review_render.py — the Qwen review to run on both renders

YOUR JOB:
1. Pick a recent completed AI Deep Dive video project (has assets/narration.mp3 + SRT, 2-3+ sections).
2. git pull ytscripts; copy spikes/001-remotion-render as the seed for a new project.
3. Port ONE section composition (prefer one with text animation) from HTML/GSAP to React/Remotion:
   - Copy markup/CSS into JSX styles verbatim
   - GSAP fromTo -> useCurrentFrame() + interpolate(frame, [start*30, (start+dur)*30], [0,1], {easing})
   - back.out eases -> spring({frame: frame - start*30, fps, config: {damping: 9, mass: 0.6, stiffness: 160}})
   - Use <Sequence from={start*30}> for timed segments; DELETE hard-kills, tl.set anchors, data-duration — they are obsolete in Remotion
   - Copy the real narration.mp3 into public/; calculateMetadata derives duration automatically
   - v4 gotcha: getAudioDurationInSeconds imports from @remotion/media-utils, NOT from remotion
4. Render: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npx remotion render src/index.ts <COMP_ID> out/<section>-remotion.mp4 (first run downloads Remotion's headless Chrome ~150MB, one-time)
5. Run review_render.py on BOTH renders with the same timestamps and section names.
6. Report back via agent_messages to debian2_bot, subject 'REPLY: Remotion fidelity test': Qwen verdict per render, per-section lines, render time, file size, any visible differences.

PASS CRITERIA: Remotion render has no BROKEN frames; section verdicts at parity (GOOD for the same sections); 1920x1080 @ 30fps with audio; duration matches the narration file.
